capabilities.rationale: Site-local learner registration, sign-in, onboarding, dashboard, and session behavior are required; authenticated source evidence is unavailable, so clone behavior is deterministic simulation through the generated auth seam.
The frozen trace matrix includes password recovery structure and validation; submission uses only the generated local recovery runtime and local outbox.
Registration and password-reset purposes are enabled only through the generated site-bound local mail templates and outbox.
Deep Learning enrollment review and seeded account history require site-local enrollment snapshots; no production order is created.
The P0 Deep Learning journey ends at a clone-local review that shows selected track and server-derived totals.
Paid track behavior is restricted to the generated local-sandbox adapter; Stripe test and live payment are forbidden.
Catalog reset, local accounts, learning progress, enrollments, history, mail, and payment ledgers require the unique site-bound SQLite runtime.
